description.narrative: Board of Directors of Oxfam Novib have decided to fund 110kEUR from its Discretionary funds for 2026-27 to support the functions ofSafeguarding regional coordination. As Oxfam Novib, we find the regional coordination function essential and hence our commitment to fund these roles for one year. We expect that in the coming financial year, the regional EA vision will have been clearly definedand designed, so that from April 2027 onwards the EAs can take the safeguarding coordination under its own region

participating-org.narrative:
We focus on empowering women to realize their rights. We work with and influence those in policymaking positions to reduce inequality and poverty. We help build resilience to disasters.
Oxfam has been working with local and national partners in Indonesia since 1957. We currently operate in seven provinces, supporting the Indonesian government, civil society, and local communities.
Gender Justice We empower women and girls in Indonesia to participate in all economic, social, political, and culturalaspects of their lives.We do this by ensuring that women have access to the resources and services necessary for them to take leadership roles and participate in decisions that affect their lives.
Economic Justice We support marginalized smallholderfarmers, especially women, to improve their food security and adapt to the impacts of climate change. We promote inclusive natural resource management and private sector accountability, to encourage respect for workers' rights.
Rights in Crisis and Climate Justice We strengthen and mobilize the capacity of urban and rural communities in Indonesia to be prepared to respond to natural disasters and to mitigate and adapt to the impacts of climate change. We promote gender mainstreaming in all emergency response efforts undertaken by the national, provincial, and local governments.
